content:
- Read .ralph/current_tasks.md and .ralph/current_tasks_done.md.
- Active candidates are five failing non-bug tasks: stories 13, 14, 15, 17, and 18.
- Checked active task files for <priority> and <blocked_by>; found no priority tags and no blockers.
- No active bug task appears in current_tasks.md, so bug-first rule does not force a bug.
- Selected story 13 object lifecycle/finalizer rules as the next logical unblocked failing task because it is the earliest remaining implementation story and precedes later write/concurrency/testing/final-acceptance work.

- Started task .ralph/tasks/13-story-object-lifecycle/01-task-implement-finalizer-and-lifecycle-rules.md.
- Task has no existing plan and no TO BE VERIFIED/NOW EXECUTE marker, so this is the required planning pass.
- Read tdd and improve-code-boundaries skills; next inspect relevant controller/API/test structure and create a plan file ending NOW EXECUTE, then quit immediately.

- Created plan .ralph/tasks/13-story-object-lifecycle/01-task-implement-finalizer-and-lifecycle-rules_plans/2026-05-19-finalizer-lifecycle-plan.md.
- Added the plan path and NOW EXECUTE marker to .ralph/tasks/13-story-object-lifecycle/01-task-implement-finalizer-and-lifecycle-rules.md.
- Planning identified likely remaining work: ensure non-deleting Observe groups get the NSXGroup finalizer, skip stale cloud sweeps after NSXNetworkCloud disappearance, and add mockapi/envtest E2E evidence for Observe vs Manage deletion and cloud deletion.
- Per task instructions, quit immediately after marking NOW EXECUTE. Next agent should read the tdd skill and execute the plan exactly, switching back to TO BE VERIFIED if design proves wrong.

- Resumed task .ralph/tasks/13-story-object-lifecycle/01-task-implement-finalizer-and-lifecycle-rules.md in NOW EXECUTE mode.
- Read required tdd and improve-code-boundaries skills, current task, and plan file.
- Next inspect stateoperator implementation/tests and run the first focused RED test for Observe finalizer behavior.

- Added RED behavior assertion to TestGroupReconcileObserveDoesNotMutateNSXOrRequeue: non-deleting Observe groups must receive nsx.ing.com/finalizer and not construct NSX client.
- Ran go test ./internal/stateoperator -run TestGroupReconcileObserveDoesNotMutateNSXOrRequeue -count=1 -v; it failed with finalizers = [], proving the missing behavior.
- Next update GroupReconciler to ensure the finalizer for non-deleting Observe groups before returning.

- Added RED TestStartSkipsCloudDeletedAfterGlobalList using a client wrapper that lists cloud-a then deletes it before per-cloud sweep.
- Ran go test ./internal/stateoperator -run TestStartSkipsCloudDeletedAfterGlobalList -count=1 -v; it failed because SweepCloud was called for the deleted cloud.
- Next update runCloudSweep to re-fetch the NSXNetworkCloud by name, skip NotFound with debug logging, and only call SweepCloud for still-present clouds.

- Added envtest/mockapi lifecycle evidence tests: Observe deletion removes Kubernetes finalizer without NSX client/delete and leaves mockapi group present; Manage deletion submits mockapi delete, keeps finalizer, then default sweep removes finalizer after a successful absent list.
- Added envtest cloud deletion evidence test: first default sweep runs with cloud present, deleting NSXNetworkCloud leaves a Manage child NSXGroup CR present, and a later default sweep does not construct a manager client for the deleted cloud.
- Focused run with KUBEBUILDER_ASSETS from .bin/setup-envtest passed all new/focused lifecycle tests.
- Next review diffs for boundary cleanliness, fix helper quality if needed, then run broader checks.

- Refactored envtest helper so startStateoperatorKubeAPIClient delegates to startStateoperatorClients, avoiding duplicate envtest bootstrap logic.
- Replaced goroutine t.Fatal assertions with channels checked from the test goroutine.
- Re-ran focused lifecycle/envtest/mockapi tests with KUBEBUILDER_ASSETS; all passed in ./internal/stateoperator.
- Next run mandatory make check, make test, and make test-coverage, then record concrete evidence in the task file.

- make check passed after lint fix and coverage lift; it ran lint, go test ./..., and go test -cover ./... with stateoperator coverage 80.2%.
- Explicit make test passed for all packages.
- Explicit make test-coverage passed for all packages; package coverage includes stateoperator 80.2%, nsxclient 80.4%, startup 80.9%, cmd 80.8%, and all other packages over 80%.
- Next finish final improve-code-boundaries review, update task evidence and passes, run task_switch, then add/commit/push everything.

- Final improve-code-boundaries pass found lifecycle logic contained in internal/stateoperator, no NSXNetworkCloud finalizer, no ownerReferences, and no duplicate lifecycle DTO/pipeline.
- Updated task file with acceptance evidence and set status completed / passes true.
- Updated plan checklist to DONE and marked completed execution/verification items.
- Next run .ralph/task_switch.sh, then git add all files, commit, and push.
